maria: Heads-up: canary p99 jumped ~18% after merge of PR #3421 (batching-heuristic-refactor) + kernel-selector tweak. Repro locally with perf harness on model=redwood/llama-vert-7b; suspect KV eviction interaction.
vikram: Saw same in perf graphs — traces show spikes during decoding when prefix cache misses. KV eviction rate up ~3x.
joan: Can you post the offending commits? I'll start git bisect locally if we can narrow base commit.
maria: Candidate commits: a1b2c3d (batching refactor), d4e5f6g (kernel-selector heuristic), 9f8e7d6 (kv eviction tuning). Repro script: `scripts/perf/repro.sh --model llama-vert-7b --batch-profile small-seq`
alan: I can run a bisect on CI. Suggest: `git bisect start HEAD v1.12.4 && git bisect run ./scripts/ci/perf-smoke.sh`
vikram: :eyes: I'll attach flamegraph from before and after.
maria: ```
perf record -F 99 -g -- ./bin/runtime --profile workload.json
./scripts/analysis/flame.py out.perf > before.svg
```
ci-bot: Canary alert: deploy 2026-03-17T22:14 triggered p99 breach on canary cluster r-infer-canary-2
joan: Plan:
1) Run local bisect reproducer to isolate commit
2) If commit is kernel-selector, try reverting that change in canary
3) If commit is batching, try switching back to old heuristics via env var BATCHING_MODE=legacy
